description: This file defines data structures and functions for parsing assistant text with embedded tags to distinguish between thinking and response segments, and for filtering visible segments.

classes.name: AssistantTextSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of assistant text, with an associated kind and unique ID.

methods.name: segments(from:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Parses raw input string into a list of AssistantTextSegment objects, optionally including or excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: visibleSegments(from:)
methods.description: Returns only the visible (non-thinking) segments from the raw input string.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Checks if the raw input string contains any visible content, considering whether to include 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:)
methods.description: Checks if the raw input string contains visible content, excluding 'thinking' segments by default.
